name: ToolRet, toolbench pool (toolbench and toolbench-sam tools)
license_summary: Each tools file has its own licence (files.<name>.license). The 13,862 toolbench_tool_* tools (config web): ToolBench data (RapidAPI endpoint documentation), Apache-2.0 per the ToolBench README. The 197 toolbench_sam_tool_* tools (config customized): NOASSERTION. They are not ToolBench's RapidAPI data but Python-library and curl function descriptions from a different upstream (ToolRet's toolbench-sam); the ToolRet dataset cards, the files' metadata and the ToolRet code README name neither their upstream nor a licence (their content matches SambaNova's ToolBench, whose repository is Apache-2.0, but that is an inference ToolRet does not state). ToolRet code: Apache-2.0; the ToolRet dataset cards declare no licence (Phase 2 spec Q2). Local-only: never committed
